children.text: Write and format content in a block editor. Drag a block up or down to reorder it. Drop it beside another block to create columns.
Hold Command on macOS or Ctrl on Windows, then click a shape to select it.
Insert math with the Σ button in the top toolbar, or press Ctrl+M. Enter expressions in TeX.
Add comments anywhere you need feedback or notes.
Switch to Whiteboard for an infinite canvas.
Choose File > Export > Export PDF to open PDF preview. On the web, open it in a new window, then use your browser’s print dialog to save it as a PDF.
Use WebMCP to let a compatible AI agent inspect and edit these elements.
